mission_m1_first_ride_desc: Your first ride on Uthao. Pick up university student Nabila and take her safely to campus gate.
obj_m1_nabila_pickup_desc: Complete the ride with Nabila to campus gate
mission_m1_fill_up_desc: Visit a fuel station to top up your tank and complete 3 rides across Mirpara.
obj_m1_fuel_desc: Refuel your motorcycle at any station
mission_m1_household_desc: Ma needs ৳1,200 for groceries and household expenses by Day 3. Earn ৳1,500 net.
obj_m1_earn_desc: Earn ৳1,500 net before the end of Day 3
mission_m2_rush_hustle_desc: Beat the morning traffic. Complete 4 trips around the bustling Mirpara market before 10:00 AM.
obj_m2_rush_rides_desc: Complete 4 market trips during morning rush (before 10:00 AM)
mission_m4_wrong_pickup_desc: A lucrative late-night request from Jamil leads into a dark dead-end lane. Keep your wits sharp.
obj_m4_survive_desc: Handle the suspicious encounter safely without robbery
obj_m4_police_desc: Cooperate with SI Morshed at the traffic checkpoint
